beaches.name: Mouda (Mounda)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established on the southern section past the hotel sunbeds. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2015 to 2022; a nudist directory entry rates it with 18 ratings and 41 comments. The beach is a loggerhead turtle nesting site and a local conservation group patrols it; no nudity designation is documented.

beaches.name: Kanali (east, at Lourdas)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established beyond the rocks west of Lourdas beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 to 2022 describing the east Kanali section as 80-100% nude; the west part is mostly textile. The beach is a Caretta caretta nesting site; no designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Spithi / Loutraki (Skala)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing continues on this beach south of Skala despite a posted sign. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2015 to 2022; a 2019 report describes a multilingual sign forbidding nudism while Greek visitors confirm naturist use. Erosion has cut the old walk from Skala and 2022 reports found the beach near-deserted.
